name: Seal, Elephant
body:
A huge and bloated seal eyes you from the shore. While slow and lethargic on land, it would be quite formidable in the water.

Elephant Seal
CR 2

XP 600
N Large animal
Init +0; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 9, flat-footed 14 (+5 natural, –1 size)
hp 22 (3d8+9)
Fort +6, Ref +3, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 40 ft.
Melee bite +7 (1d8+9)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks trample (2d6+9, DC 17)

STATISTICS

Str 23, Dex 10, Con 17, Int 2, Wis 11, Cha 4
Base Atk +2; CMB +9; CMD 19
Feats Endurance, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Perception +9 SQ hold breath

Source Wikipedia

ECOLOGY

Environment any coast
Organization solitary, pair, or pod (3-10)
Treasure none

Elephant seals take their name from the large proboscis of the adult males (bulls) which resembles an elephant’s trunk. The bull’s proboscis is used in producing extraordinarily loud roaring noises, especially during the mating season. Elephant seals reach a length of 16 to 20 feet, and can be fiercely territorial.
